name: Gmail Email — Send
author: hearth-team
description: Send email through your Gmail account via Google OAuth. Uses the minimum-privilege gmail.send scope — this skill can compose and send email but physically cannot read your inbox. Pair with Gmail Email — Read if your agent also needs inbox visibility.

vault_inputs.label: Google OAuth client ID
vault_inputs.help: One-time setup: console.cloud.google.com → APIs & Services → Library → enable 'Gmail API' → Credentials → Create Credentials → OAuth client ID → type 'Web application' → add http://localhost:3000/oauth/callback as an Authorized redirect URI (used by the one-click Connect button). Paste the Client ID here. Same client serves all Google skills.

vault_inputs.label: Google OAuth client secret
vault_inputs.help: The 'Client secret' shown next to the Client ID in the Cloud Console Credentials list. Stored encrypted in your vault. If you ever rotate it, paste the new value here and click Save.

vault_inputs.label: Gmail send refresh token (manual fallback)
vault_inputs.help: OPTIONAL — the 'Connect Google' button above does this in one click. Manual path: developers.google.com/oauthplayground → gear icon → 'Use your own OAuth credentials' → paste Client ID + secret → Step 1: tick ONLY https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.send (send-only scope) → Authorize → Step 2: Exchange authorization code → copy the Refresh token here.

vault_inputs.label: From name (optional)
vault_inputs.help: Display name shown to recipients. Leave blank to use just the email address.
